blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutor and Bicol Saro Party-list Rep. Terry Ridon on Wednesday hailed the dismissal by the Supreme Court of the petitions challenging the Senate Impeachment Court’s ruling on the voting threshold to convict Vice President Sara Duterte. Ridon emphasized that their work on impeachment proceedings will continue. The SC has junked separate petitions filed by former Executive Secretary Vic Rodriguex and lawyer Ernesto Francisco Jr. due to procedural lapses. The petitioners sought for judicial intervention after the Senate voted on the 16-vote threshold needed to convict Duterte. “We thank the Supreme Court for dismissing the petitions against the […]...
